title: Brazilian Caramel Tart with Almond Crumble
description: A sweet and nutty dessert featuring a caramel filling topped with a crunchy almond crumble. A perfect treat for warm evenings.
instructions: Prepare the almond crumble by mixing together almond flour, crisp rice cereal, nutty nut butter, and brazilian sea salt in a bowl until well combined.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch (23cm) tart pan.
Melt the butter and granulated sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the egg until well combined.
Pour the caramel filling into the prepared tart crust.
Top with the almond crumble and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the tart to cool completely before serving.
